import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.dates as mdates  # noqa: E402
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import pandas as pd  # noqa: E402

PANELS = [
    ("PRCP", "Precipitation"),
    ("TMAX", "Maximum temperature"),
    ("TMIN", "Minimum temperature"),
]
CURRENT_END = pd.Timestamp("2025-03-01")
FIG_TITLE = "Corvallis, OR (USC00351862): winter 2025 vs 10-year average"


def main(inputs, outputs, params):
    # inputs["input1"] is a folder holding every variable_summary_<rank>.csv, and only those.
    folder = inputs["input1"]
    names = sorted(os.listdir(folder))
    if not names:
        msg = f"ERROR: the input folder {folder} holds no summary files"
        print(msg, flush=True)
        raise FileNotFoundError(msg)
    print(f"Found {len(names)} summary files: {', '.join(names)}", flush=True)

    tables = {}
    for name in names:
        df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(folder, name))
        required = {"date", "variable", "current_year", "avg_10yr", "units"}
        missing_cols = required - set(df.columns)
        if missing_cols:
            msg = f"ERROR: {name} missing columns {sorted(missing_cols)}"
            print(msg, flush=True)
            raise ValueError(msg)
        for var, sub in df.groupby("variable"):
            var = str(var).strip()
            if var in tables:
                msg = f"ERROR: variable {var} appears in more than one summary file"
                print(msg, flush=True)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            tables[var] = sub.copy()

    missing = [v for v, _ in PANELS if v not in tables]
    if missing:
        msg = f"ERROR: missing variable(s) {missing}; found {sorted(tables)}"
        print(msg, flush=True)
        raise ValueError(msg)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 11), sharex=True)
    for ax, (var, label) in zip(axes, PANELS):
        df = tables[var]
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        units = str(df["units"].dropna().iloc[0]) if df["units"].notna().any() else ""
        cur = df[df["date"] <= CURRENT_END]
        ax.plot(df["date"], df["avg_10yr"], linestyle="--", color="tab:gray",
                label="2015-2024 average")
        ax.plot(cur["date"], cur["current_year"], linestyle="-", color="tab:blue",
                label="2025")
        ax.set_title(label)
        ax.set_ylabel(f"{label} ({units})")
        ax.legend(loc="best")
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[-1].set_xlim(pd.Timestamp("2025-01-01"), pd.Timestamp("2025-03-31"))
    axes[-1].xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator(bymonthday=[1, 15]))
    axes[-1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b-%d"))
    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Date")
    fig.suptitle(FIG_TITLE)
    fig.tight_layout()

    fig.savefig(outputs["output1"], dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Wrote {outputs['output1']}", flush=True)
